response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Paragraph: \"In the natural world our “old man” has the tendency...\"","severity":"major","source_quote":"In the natural world our “old man” has the tendency to think that we must “do something” if we expect things to go in a “right” direction.","suggested_fix":"Translate the phrase “our ‘old man’” to standard Kiswahili theological terminology (do not render it as “neno letu la kale”). Keep the rest of the sentence consistent with the source.","translation_quote":"Kwenye ulimwengu wa kawaida neno letu la kale lina tabia ya kudhani kwamba lazima “tufanye jambo” tukitarajia mambo yaende kwa mwelekeo “sahihi”."},{"location":"Paragraph: sentence that refers to “Abba Father”","severity":"major","source_quote":"Let’s allow this article to help us to become rooted and grounded in the biblical Truth of Abba Father—a Father who cares for His children.","suggested_fix":"Correct the mistranslation “Kiarabu cha Abba Baba”, which wrongly reads as “Arabic of Abba Father”.
